title: My feedback
body: This app feels like a scam. Why will they be asking for my picture. If they know I can’t use the app if I don’t subscribe. I just imagine after giving them the picture of me they asked for. I wasn’t able to use the app because I haven’t subscribe. Why didn’t you people ask for subscription. Before asking me to give my picture. Please if you are planning to download this app. Be ready to subscribe 19,900 thousand naira monthly. And 69,900 annually
author: Binzu Williams
